Biophysical Chemistry 17(2), doi 10.4236/jbpc.2026.172002, preregistered osf.io/nt76h/overview. A claim that had lived a decade in ONE lab (Persinger, Laurentian) was tested as the Yard prescribes: automated Arduino rig, two ~20 nT toroidal halos, Local (acid) / Remote (nothing) / Control (unexposed) beakers, 50 experimental + 50 SHAM runs, difference-of-differences scalar, permutation inference. RESULT: exp ΔD +0.0034 vs sham -0.0007, between-group +0.0041, p = 0.005; sham null; two negative controls null (p = 0.26 / 0.27); 15 of 81 sensitivity-grid windows survive FWER (global p = 0.018), all predicted-direction. CAVEATS FILED WITH THE RESULT, NOT AFTER IT: effect is 3x the probe's 0.001 pH floor; venue is SCIRP (low-credibility publisher, and essentially the whole prior 'excess correlation' literature is in the same house); the PREREGISTERED SECONDARY MODEL WAS NULL (p ~ 0.48 — a ~2-minute transient, not a sustained state); the replicator is himself a psi researcher with a prior positive pilot. LABEL: single-source, unconfirmed positive. This rail held ONLY FAILURES before (Benveniste 1988 + 18 yrs of re-tests) — an all-failure pavilion reads as 'this never works'. (2) LENR — university-affiliated positive with a large COP and a weak product signal: Winzeler (ZHAW Zurich), JCMNS 41:153-161 (2026), doi 10.70923/001c.163383, ICCF-26 Morioka. Quartz-glass reactor, inductive HF excitation, Pd-coated + pure Ni foils, repeatable activation by gradual pressure reduction and deactivation by short H pulses, COP 1.4-2.4, SEM localised melting/pores, EDX shows C/O/Al/Si. THE TRANSMUTATION HALF DOES NOT SURVIVE INSPECTION: EDX sees elements not isotopes, and C/O/Al/Si are what a quartz chamber and handling deposit — ONE OBSERVABLE, NOT TWO (Dossier 021 rule); no SIMS/ICP-MS/isotopic ratios. ABSTRACT-ONLY read. LENR ladder now 5 rungs of 4 different kinds (Callisto 9-yr null / Nature Comms 2026 nucleus positive / Kasagi JCMNS 41 ~1.1 W / Chen Nature 644 with built-in electrolyte control / this) — 2 nulls, and the pattern is that the OBSERVABLE CLASS decides what can be concluded. (3) ANTHROPOSOPHICAL / biodynamic — FIRST RECORD IN A DOMAIN THAT HELD ZERO: Spoerk Gabriel & Goldstein, Research Square preprint doi 10.21203/rs.3.rs-9059525/v1 (under revision, NOT peer reviewed), two growth-chamber experiments on spring wheat, two soils (pasture Rygge / biodynamic Alm Gaard), N held equal at 60 kg/ha: preparations ENHANCE growth and yield where N is not limiting and are slightly INHIBITORY where it is; biodynamic compost strongest on the biodynamic soil; mature compost out-supplied mineral N.
